## Definition of done

- [ ] The PR targets `develop-release_1`, covers one topic, and is small.
- [ ] It builds without warnings (`-Wall -Wextra -Werror` or `/W4 /WX`). All tests pass locally,
      and `ci-ok` is green.
- [ ] Changed or new behaviour has tests.
- [ ] If anything user-visible changed (behaviour, build, packaging, support), README.md and
      LEGENDUM.md are updated in the same PR, with the same structure and examples.
- [ ] New decisions are logged in `Copilot/DECISIONS.md`, and answered questions are recorded in
      `Copilot/QUESTIONS.md`.
- [ ] `Copilot/PLAN.md` has the updated status table, and the next task is planned in full.
